question: What spoken question answering accuracy does Moshi reach on Web Questions, Llama Questions and Audio TriviaQA, with and without Inner Monologue?
final_text: I couldn't find this in the passages I retrieved from the three papers, so I won't guess. I searched: MOSHI §5.4 Audio language modeling; MOSHI §5.5 Spoken question answering; MOSHI §4.3 Speech-Text Instruct data; MOSHI §1 Introduction.
drafts: The authors report that Moshi without Inner Monologue achieves 9.2 % accuracy on Web Questions, 21.0 % on Llama Questions, and 7.3 % on Audio TriviaQA [MOSHI:T8:r02]. The retrieved passages do not state the spoken question answering accuracy of Moshi with Inner Monologue.

The authors report that Moshi (no Inner Monologue) achieves 9.2 % accuracy on Web Questions, 21.0 % on Llama Questions, and 7.3 % on Audio TriviaQA [MOSHI:T8:r02]. The authors also report that Moshi (with Inner Monologue) achieves 26.6 % accuracy on Web Questions, 62.3 % on Llama Questions, and 22.8 % on Audio TriviaQA [MOSHI:T8:r01].
